obligations.clock_relationship: Qualify block clock relationships, phase/skew and generated clocks
obligations.clock_uncertainty: Supply block setup and hold uncertainty at the selected corners
obligations.reset_cdc: Qualify shadow reset mapping, reset release, CDC and alert synchronizers
obligations.input_delays: Supply min/max arrivals and reference clocks for each non-clock input
obligations.output_delays: Supply min/max required times and reference clocks for each output
obligations.electrical: Supply input transitions or driving cells, and output loads
obligations.exceptions: Review and substantiate asynchronous, false-path and multicycle exceptions
obligations.path_groups: Bind endpoint groups to clock and interface obligations
